annotations.title: Faith in the same.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> This faith is not an other in substance then the common faith in Christ, but is of an other accidental qualitie onely, that is, of more feruor, deuotiõ, zeale, and confident trust, specially for doing of miracles.

annotations.title: If the foote.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> The Church is of exceding great distinctiõ of members, giftes, orders, and offices: yet of great concord, concurrence, mutual communion and participation in al actions of her members among them selues, and vvith Christ the head of the Body.

annotations.title: Schisme in the body.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> As Charitie and vnitie of spirit, is the proper bond and vveale of the common Body: so is diuision or Schisme, vvhich is the interruption of peace and mutual Societie betvvene the partes of the same, the special plague of the Church, and as odious to God as rebellion to the temporal Soueraine.
